finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the email content contains malicious characters that could be interpreted as shell commands.
finding.assumptions: The email content is attacker-controlled and could potentially contain malicious characters.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The email content is a string literal and is not attacker-controlled. The content is hardcoded and does not come from an untrusted source such as stdin, a file, the network, argv, environment variables, IPC, or a parameter of a public API controlled by the caller.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the size of the email content exceeds the allocated buffer size.
finding.assumptions: The buffer size is not checked against the size of the email content.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the size of the email content against the allocated buffer size using std::min(size * nmemb, email_data->size) on line 19.
